graphs.title: 03 · 分阶段MCP查询状态机
graphs.intent: 工具调用本身不推理。上游Nexent负责调度；程序以数据库状态决定是否允许下一步。

nodes.name: govkb_open_query → open_query
nodes.detail: 固定快照与事实，创建staged任务；没有证据需求可直接can_finalize。

nodes.name: needs_retrieval
nodes.detail: retrieve_query只在此状态且rounds<3取登记的所需证据。

nodes.name: needs_verification
nodes.detail: verify_query精确核对ID、span及quote；累计found_ids与rounds。

nodes.name: can_finalize
nodes.detail: 无缺口，或已到第3轮；剩余缺证据项仍unknown。

nodes.name: complete
nodes.detail: finalize_query每次重读live gate；首次持久化answer，重试不重复创建任务。

nodes.name: 拒绝不合法调用
nodes.detail: STAGED_QUERY_REQUIRED / RETRIEVAL_NOT_ALLOWED / VERIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED / QUERY_NOT_VALIDATED。

nodes.name: govkb_query_state
nodes.detail: 只读持久化status、轮数和version；主控不用子Agent自然语言冒充已执行。

edges: 非法任务/状态调用均拒绝

graphs.title: 04 · 变更发现、暂停、复核与原子发布
graphs.intent: 此图对应8780模拟更新实现。关键点是先暂停受影响项；文档可检索不等于业务规则已发布。

nodes.name: heartbeat(force=False)
nodes.detail: 30秒ticker；paused且非force则返回；单写租约120秒、轮预算600秒。

nodes.name: Store.claim
nodes.detail: 租约有效→already_running；接管时fence递增，旧running标interrupted。

nodes.name: _check(source, run, interval)
nodes.detail: 比较来源＋内容＋配置指纹；unchanged只更新检查时间；失败记来源错误。

nodes.name: 立即落库package + block
nodes.detail: 新包processing/discovered；旧未发布包superseded；受影响requirement即刻暂停。

nodes.name: _process的持久化阶段
nodes.detail: discovered→classified→extracted→validated→awaiting_review；租约失效拒绝写入。

nodes.name: 写documents与本地稀疏索引
nodes.detail: wf_documents推进；候选可供查看，但不切换wf_head业务知识。

nodes.name: review(package_id, object_ids)
nodes.detail: 专业角色选择accepted/rejected，记录actor＋basis_hash；拒绝项继续暂停。

nodes.name: publish：BEGIN IMMEDIATE
nodes.detail: expected_head必须等于当前头；包仍awaiting_review，source_guard仍有效。

nodes.name: 复核与依赖是否仍一致？
nodes.detail: 同actor已accepted、basis_hash匹配；候选依赖相对base未变。

nodes.name: 创建并校验新快照
nodes.detail: 合并所选要求/别名；本体提案executable=false；完整图、review及span验证。

nodes.name: 原子切换wf_head
nodes.detail: 写wf_versions、ontology_version、accepted_hash、package状态及审计；COMMIT。

nodes.name: 任一验证失败：ROLLBACK
nodes.detail: 不留下半发布；expected_head错误返回BASE_VERSION_CHANGED。

nodes.name: 显式rollback(target, expected_head)
nodes.detail: 仅切换历史头；旧block不自动清除，返回前继续检查当前暂停。

edges: 获租约；每轮最多3包/来源

graphs.title: 05 · 决策工作台的数据结构
graphs.intent: 实线是代码读写关系；虚线是JSON里的逻辑引用，不是数据库声明的外键。

nodes.name: Workflow读写层
nodes.detail: 所有业务记录按kind＋id存在wf_records；短事务与版本指纹由程序控制。

nodes.name: state(key PK, value JSON)
nodes.detail: wf_head=业务快照ID；wf_documents=当前文档；wf_control=暂停/间隔；lease=单写租约。

nodes.name: wf_records(kind, id, payload)
nodes.detail: PRIMARY KEY(kind,id)。query / source / package / block / trace / documents / ontology_version / audit_gate。

nodes.name: wf_versions(id PK, payload)
nodes.detail: id=规范化snapshot的SHA256；payload包含base、actor、created_at、snapshot。

nodes.name: query payload
nodes.detail: version_id、facts、branch_id、draft、rounds、found_ids、status、answer；staged查询分步骤推进。

nodes.name: package payload
nodes.detail: source_id、fingerprint、base、stage、candidates、reviews、published；basis_hash绑定逐项复核。

nodes.name: block payload
nodes.detail: object_id、package_id、reason、accepted_hash；仅已接受新内容的哈希解除对应暂停。

nodes.name: runs / jobs
nodes.detail: Store的租约run使用owner＋fence＋deadline；工作台复用run，公开采集器另有自己的jobs表。

nodes.name: audit(id, time, operation, payload)
nodes.detail: 记录人工复核、发布、回退、失败；wf_records的trace另记录角色/工具及输入输出哈希。

graphs.title: 08 · 填表核查、编辑失效与咨询提交
graphs.intent: 表单原回答留本机会话；外发只含选项代码。DeepSeek仅核对格式，无工具和提交权限。

steps.label: POST /api/forms/start {}
GuidedForm(workflow)：固定字段与版本；有效期30分钟
POST answer：form_id、revision、field_id、answer
会话归属＋revision校验；answer按顺序唯一匹配选项
编辑→revision++；reviewed=None；原确认立即失效
POST review：consent=true
完整表单＋开关＋预算：全局20/会话3；并发槽2
to_thread(form.review)：校验字段schema与当前快照
同草稿/版本/规范值缓存可复用；否则verify(template, values)
返回JSON；value类型和值、display、unknown_fields均必须精确一致
human_review：review_id + revision + 允许分支
显示核查结果；仍需人工逐项确认
POST submit：acknowledge=true、review_id、revision、branch_id
submit：复核ID/版本/分支有效；重复同分支复用回执
query(facts, branch_id, version_id, expected_head)
本地咨询回执；清原回答和缓存；official_submission=false
返回receipt＋当前可用性答复
失败分支：过期/改值/换版本/无确认/预算耗尽→拒绝；不自动补事实

def worker_once(store, fetcher=None, owner=None, now=None):
    now, owner = time.time() if now is None else now, owner or "worker-" + secrets.token_hex(4)
    fetcher = fetcher or Fetcher(store)
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        db.execute("INSERT INTO workers VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET heartbeat=excluded.heartbeat,progress=excluded.progress", (owner, now, "polling"))
        job = db.execute("SELECT j.*,s.config,s.paused_reason FROM jobs j JOIN sites s ON s.id=j.site_id LEFT JOIN discovery_targets t ON t.site_id=j.site_id AND t.url=j.url WHERE ((j.state='queued' AND j.due<=?) OR (j.state='running' AND j.lease_until<?)) AND j.attempts<3 AND s.paused_reason IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs other WHERE other.id!=j.id AND other.site_id=j.site_id AND other.state='running' AND other.lease_until>=?) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.kind IN ('index','rss','atom','sitemap') THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_visits v WHERE v.cycle_id=t.cycle_id AND v.url=j.url AND v.is_new=1) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,j.id LIMIT 1", (now, now, now)).fetchone()
        if not job:
            return False
        config = json.loads(job["config"])
        if not config["enabled"]:
            db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='failed',error='SOURCE_DISABLED' WHERE id=?", (job["id"],))
            return True
        db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='running',attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=?,owner=? WHERE id=?", (now+(600 if config.get("pdf_ocr") else 180), owner, job["id"]))
    try:
        from gov_mcp.knowledge_discovery import INDEX_KINDS, XML_TYPES, record_index, target_kind
        with store.db() as db:
            kind = target_kind(db, config, job["url"])
        is_index = kind in INDEX_KINDS
        status, headers, raw, final_url = fetcher.fetch(config, job["url"])
        if status not in (200, 304):
            raise ValueError(f"HTTP_{status}; unavailable does not imply revoked")
        if is_index and config.get("discover_links"):
            content_type = headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0].strip().lower()
            if status == 200 and (kind == "index" and content_type not in ("text/html", "application/xhtml+xml") or kind != "index" and content_type not in XML_TYPES):
                raise ValueError("Discovery format does not match approved index type")
            record_index(store, config, job["url"], kind, raw if status == 200 else None, final_url, now)
        elif status == 304 and not is_index:
            from gov_mcp.knowledge_discovery import refresh_unchanged_document
            refresh_unchanged_document(store, config, job["url"])
            if config.get("attachment_discovery"):
                with store.db() as db:
                    latest = db.execute("SELECT r.* FROM revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id=r.document_id WHERE d.site_id=? AND d.url=? ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (config["id"], job["url"])).fetchone()
                    store._verify(db, latest["id"], require_review=False)
                if json.loads(latest["metadata"]).get("source_observation", {}).get("media_type") == "text/html":
                    from gov_mcp.knowledge_attachments import discover_attachments
                    original = store.root / "originals" / latest["sha256"][:2] / latest["sha256"]
                    discover_attachments(store, config, latest["id"], original.read_bytes(), now)
        elif status == 200 and not is_index:
            article_preface = None
            pdf_extraction = None
            content_type = headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0].strip()
            if config.get("attachment_only") and (content_type != "application/pdf" or not raw.startswith(b"%PDF-")):
                raise ValueError("Attachment collector requires an actual PDF response, not an HTML error or landing page")
            if content_type not in ("text/html", "application/xhtml+xml", "application/pdf"):
                raise ValueError("Unsupported format; requires dedicated parser")
            if content_type == "application/pdf":
                if config.get("include_articles") or config.get("include_paragraph_keywords") or config.get("include_paragraph_keyword_groups"):
                    raise ValueError("Configured HTML selection cannot be applied to PDF")
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="parse-", dir=store.root) as directory:
                    from pathlib import Path
                    path = Path(directory) / "input.pdf"
                    path.write_bytes(raw)
                    try:
                        command = [sys.executable, "-m", "gov_mcp.knowledge_pdf", str(path)]
                        if config.get("pdf_ocr"):
                            command.append("--windows-ocr")
                        parsed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=150 if config.get("pdf_ocr") else 30,
                            check=False, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == "win32" else 0)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                        raise ValueError("PDF parsing timed out") from error
                    if parsed.returncode or len(parsed.stdout) > MAX_BYTES:
                        raise ValueError("PDF parser failed; inspect isolated input")
                    document = json.loads(parsed.stdout)
                    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("schema") != 1 or not isinstance(document.get("chunks"), list) or not isinstance(document.get("extraction"), dict):
                        raise ValueError("Bounded PDF extraction protocol required")
                    chunks, links, pdf_extraction = document["chunks"], [], document["extraction"]
            else:
                chunks, links = parse_html(raw, config.get("content_selector"), min_text_length=1 if config.get("include_articles") else 8,
                                           excluded_selectors=config.get("excluded_content_selectors"))
                if config.get("include_paragraph_keywords"):
                    chunks = select_paragraph_keywords(chunks, config["include_paragraph_keywords"], config.get("paragraph_expected_count", 1))
                if config.get("include_paragraph_keyword_groups"):
                    chunks = select_paragraph_groups(chunks, config["include_paragraph_keyword_groups"])
                if config.get("include_articles"):
                    chunks, article_preface = article_section(chunks, config.get("article_start_title"))
                    chunks = select_articles(chunks, config["include_articles"], config.get("article_categories"))
            if not is_index:
                if not chunks:
                    raise ValueError("No selected article body; quarantined")
                metadata = dict(config["metadata"])
                # A fetched change cannot inherit the old revision's effective/publication dates.
                metadata.update(effective_from=None, effective_to=None, published_at=None)
                metadata["source_observation"] = (
                    {"schema": 1, "media_type": "application/pdf", "raw_sha256": fingerprint(raw)}
                    if content_type == "application/pdf" else observe_html(raw, config.get("metadata_selectors"),
                        content_selector=config.get("content_selector"), excluded_selectors=config.get("excluded_content_selectors")))
                if pdf_extraction:
                    metadata["source_observation"]["pdf_extraction"] = pdf_extraction
                if article_preface is not None:
                    metadata["source_observation"]["selected_article_preface"] = article_preface
                from gov_mcp.knowledge_discovery import document_discovery_signal
                with store.db() as db:
                    observed = document_discovery_signal(db, config, job["url"])
                if job["url"] not in config["seeds"] or observed:
                    metadata["title"] = "待复核文件：" + final_url
                    if observed:
                        metadata["title"] = observed["title"] or metadata["title"]
                        metadata["title_source"] = "source_"+str(observed.get("discovery_format", "index"))+"_entry_pending_document_verification"
                        metadata["discovered_from"] = observed.get("discovered_from")
                        metadata["source_observation"]["discovery_signal"] = {key: observed.get(key) for key in ("title", "hints", "discovery_format")}
                revision = store.ingest(config["id"], job["url"], raw, metadata, chunks, preserve_metadata_if_unchanged=True)
                store.propose_classification(revision)
                if config.get("attachment_discovery") and content_type in ("text/html", "application/xhtml+xml"):
                    from gov_mcp.knowledge_attachments import discover_attachments
                    discover_attachments(store, config, revision, raw, now)
        with store.db() as db:
            db.execute("INSERT INTO resources VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(site_id,url) DO UPDATE SET etag=COALESCE(excluded.etag,resources.etag),modified=COALESCE(excluded.modified,resources.modified),checked_at=excluded.checked_at",
                       (config["id"], job["url"], headers.get("etag"), headers.get("last-modified"), now))
            db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='done',error=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=? AND owner=?", (job["id"], owner))
            unfinished = db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE site_id=? AND state!='done' LIMIT 1", (config["id"],)).fetchone()
            if not unfinished:
                db.execute("UPDATE sites SET last_success=?,failures=0 WHERE id=?", (now, config["id"]))
            store.log(db, "check_succeeded", {"site": config["id"], "status": status})
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError, http.client.HTTPException) as error:
        with store.db() as db:
            stopped = isinstance(error, AccessStopped)
            state = "failed" if stopped or job["attempts"]+1 >= 3 else "queued"
            delay = error.delay if isinstance(error, RetryLater) else (60, 300, 1800)[job["attempts"]]
            db.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state=?,due=?,lease_until=NULL,error=? WHERE id=? AND owner=?", (state, now+delay, str(error)[:300], job["id"], owner))
            db.execute("UPDATE sites SET failures=failures+1,paused_reason=CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE paused_reason END WHERE id=?", (stopped, str(error)[:300], config["id"]))
            failure = {"site": config["id"], "reason": str(error)[:300]}
            if stopped:
                failure["access_stop"] = error.detail()
            store.log(db, "check_failed", failure)
    with store.db() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE workers SET heartbeat=?,progress='idle' WHERE id=?", (time.time(), owner))
    return True

def _execute_query(self, task, version, draft, retriever, *, expected_head=None):
        task_id, branch_id = task["id"], task["branch_id"]
        found = set()
        evidence = {e["id"]: e for e in version["snapshot"]["evidence"]}
        for number in range(1, 4):
            requested = self._evidence_request(draft, found)
            if not requested:
                break
            result = self.roles.invoke("retriever", "retrieve_registered_evidence", lambda:
                retriever(number, list(requested), deepcopy(version["snapshot"])) if retriever else requested)
            retrieved = {"round": number, "requested": requested, "evidence": [evidence[key] for key in result if key in evidence]}
            record = self.roles.invoke("query_verifier", "verify_conditions", lambda:
                self._verify_retrieval(draft, version["snapshot"], retrieved, found))
            found.update(record["found"])
            with self.store.db(True) as db:
                task["rounds"].append(record)
                self.put("query", task_id, task, db)
                self._event("retriever", "retrieve_registered_evidence", {"round": number, "ids": requested}, {"ids": record["found"]}, task=task_id, db=db)
                self._event("query_verifier", "verify_conditions", {"evidence_ids": sorted(found)}, record, task=task_id, db=db)
            if not record["needs_more"]: break
        for row in draft["rows"]:
            if {e["id"] for e in row["evidence"]} - found:
                row.update(result="unknown", reason="EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL_INCOMPLETE")
        task["draft"] = draft
        # The gate and durable answer are read/written in ONE serialized transaction.
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            if expected_head is not None and self.store.get("state", "wf_head", db) != expected_head:
                raise WorkflowError("FORM_VERSION_CHANGED")
            service = self._service(version, db)
            service._tasks[task_id] = draft
            answer = self.roles.invoke("query_controller", "compose_answer", lambda: service.finalize(task_id))
            answer.update(task_id=task_id, version_id=version["id"], retrieval_rounds=len(task["rounds"]),
                          execution_mode="offline_engineering_only", agent_model_calls=0, question_used_as_instruction=False)
            docs = self.store.get("state", "wf_documents", db)
            answer["documents_version"] = docs["id"]
            answer["candidate_evidence"] = [{"package_id": p["id"], "evidence": c["evidence"], "asset": c["asset"],
                "applicability": "待专业人员核实，不加入确定清单"} for p in self._packages(("awaiting_review", "partially_published"), db)
                for c in p["candidates"]
                if c["object_id"] not in p["published"] and c["record"]["branch_id"] in {b.id for b in service._path(branch_id)}]
            task.update(status="complete", answer=answer, finished_at=self.clock())
            self.put("query", task_id, task, db)
            self._event("query_controller", "compose_answer", {"rounds": len(task["rounds"])}, {"counts": answer["counts"]}, task=task_id, db=db)
        return answer

def finalize(self, task_id):
        with self._task_lock:
            if task_id not in self._tasks:
                raise DecisionError("UNKNOWN_TASK")
            draft = deepcopy(self._tasks[task_id])
        # Re-read current suspensions even when the task uses an older fixed snapshot.
        with self.availability.lock:
            checklist, pending, excluded, paused = [], [], [], []
            for row in draft["rows"]:
                blockers = sorted(set(row["dependency_ids"]) & self.availability.suspended.keys())
                if blockers:
                    row.update(result="paused", message=MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE,
                               suspension=[deepcopy(self.availability.suspended[key]) for key in blockers])
                    paused.append(row)
                elif draft["branch_result"] == "false":
                    if row["review_status"] == "confirmed":
                        row.update(result="false", reason="SELECTED_BRANCH_NOT_APPLICABLE")
                        excluded.append(row)
                elif row["result"] == "true":
                    checklist.append(row)
                elif row["result"] == "false":
                    excluded.append(row)
                else:
                    row["applicability_note"] = "原文事实仅供核对，尚不能确定为本次办事要求。"
                    pending.append(row)
            stages = [{"stage_id": s.id, "label": s.label,
                       "items": [row for row in checklist if row["stage_id"] == s.id]}
                      for s in sorted(self._snapshot.stages, key=lambda s: (s.order, s.id))]
            missing = sorted({field for row in pending for field in row["missing_fields"]})
            if not draft["rows"] and draft["branch_result"] == "unknown":
                missing = sorted({field for c in draft["branch_conditions"] for field in c["missing_fields"]})
            aliases = [{"material_id": alias.material_id, "label": alias.label, "evidence_ids": alias.evidence_ids}
                       for alias in self._snapshot.aliases
                       if alias.review_status == "confirmed" and not
                       (self._record_dependencies([alias]) | {alias.material_id}) & self.availability.suspended.keys()]
            next_branches = self.branch_options(draft["facts"], draft["branch_id"])
            status = ("branch_not_applicable" if draft["branch_result"] == "false" else
                      "needs_branch_selection" if not draft["rows"] and next_branches else
                      "no_confirmed_requirements" if not draft["rows"] else
                      "partial" if checklist and (pending or paused) else "ready" if checklist else
                      "paused" if paused else "insufficient_evidence")
            result = {"mode": self._snapshot.mode, "real_policy_advice": False, "model_calls": 0,
                      "task_id": task_id, "snapshot_sha256": self._fingerprint,
                      "versions": self._snapshot.versions.model_dump(), "availability_epoch": self.availability.epoch,
                      "matter": self._snapshot.matter.model_dump(), "branch_id": draft["branch_id"],
                      "status": status, "next_branches": next_branches,
                      "branch_result": draft["branch_result"], "region_id": draft["region_id"], "as_of": draft["as_of"],
                      "stages": stages, "pending": pending, "excluded": excluded, "paused": paused,
                      "confirmed_aliases": aliases,
                      "follow_up": {"optional": True, "enabled": bool(missing), "label": "补充情况", "fields": [self._fields[f] for f in missing]},
                      "counts": {"confirmed": len(checklist), "pending": len(pending), "excluded": len(excluded), "paused": len(paused)}}
            # Return JSON-safe values and never expose references to internal snapshot/task data.
            json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
            return deepcopy(result)

def open_query(self, facts, branch_id, question=""):
        """Staged MCP entry: pin data once; a native controller can call children next."""
        if not isinstance(question, str) or len(question) > 2000: raise WorkflowError("INVALID_QUESTION")
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            version = self.version(db=db)
            service = self._service(version, db)
            key = service.prepare(facts, branch_id)
            draft = deepcopy(service._tasks[key])
            task = {"id": key, "parent_task": None, "version_id": version["id"], "facts": draft["facts"],
                    "branch_id": branch_id, "as_of": draft["as_of"], "question": question, "created_at": self.clock(),
                    "status": "needs_retrieval", "rounds": [], "draft": draft, "answer": None,
                    "staged": True, "found_ids": [], "retrieval": None}
            if not self._evidence_request(draft):
                task["status"] = "can_finalize"
            self.put("query", key, task, db)
            self._event("query_controller", "open_query", {"branch_id": branch_id}, {"task_id": key, "version_id": version["id"]}, task=key, db=db)
            return {"task_id": key, "version_id": version["id"], "status": task["status"], "max_rounds": 3}

def retrieve_query(self, task_id):
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            task = self.get("query", task_id, db)
            if not task or not task.get("staged"): raise WorkflowError("STAGED_QUERY_REQUIRED")
            if task["status"] == "needs_verification": return deepcopy(task["retrieval"])  # Idempotent retry.
            if task["status"] != "needs_retrieval" or len(task["rounds"]) >= 3: raise WorkflowError("RETRIEVAL_NOT_ALLOWED")
            snapshot = self.version(task["version_id"], db)["snapshot"]
            requested = self._evidence_request(task["draft"], task["found_ids"])
            found = [e for e in snapshot["evidence"] if e["id"] in requested]
            # Native roles cannot choose arbitrary URLs or mutate the evidence set.
            value = {"task_id": task_id, "round": len(task["rounds"])+1, "requested": sorted(requested), "evidence": found,
                     "version_id": task["version_id"]}
            task.update(status="needs_verification", retrieval=value)
            self.put("query", task_id, task, db)
            self._event("retriever", "retrieve_query", {"task_id": task_id}, value, task=task_id, db=db)
            return value

def finalize_query(self, task_id):
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            task = self.get("query", task_id, db)
            if not task or not task.get("staged"): raise WorkflowError("STAGED_QUERY_REQUIRED")
            if task["status"] not in {"can_finalize", "complete"}: raise WorkflowError("QUERY_NOT_VALIDATED")
            version = self.version(task["version_id"], db)
            service = self._service(version, db)
            draft = deepcopy(task["draft"])
            for row in draft["rows"]:
                if {e["id"] for e in row["evidence"]}-set(task["found_ids"]):
                    row.update(result="unknown", reason="EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL_INCOMPLETE")
            service._tasks[task_id] = draft
            answer = service.finalize(task_id)  # Rechecks live gate even for retries/old snapshots.
            answer.update(version_id=task["version_id"], retrieval_rounds=len(task["rounds"]),
                          execution_mode="staged_program_tools", agent_model_calls=None,
                          model_calls_scope="upstream Nexent inference is recorded separately; these tools do not infer")
            if task["answer"] is None:
                task.update(answer=answer, draft=draft, status="complete", finished_at=self.clock())
                self.put("query", task_id, task, db)
                self._event("query_controller", "finalize_query", {"task_id": task_id}, {"counts": answer["counts"]}, task=task_id, db=db)
            return answer

def _check(self, source, run, interval):
        try:
            packet = self._packet(source)
        except WorkflowError as error:
            with self.store.db(True) as db:
                self.store.assert_lease(run, db)
                latest = self.get("source", source["id"], db)
                if not latest or latest["profile"] != source["profile"]: return
                source.update(status="failed", error=str(error), last_check=self.clock(), next_check=self.clock()+interval)
                self.put("source", source["id"], source, db)
            return
        identity = self._source_hash(source, packet)
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            self.store.assert_lease(run, db)
            latest = self.get("source", source["id"], db)
            if not latest or not latest["enabled"] or not latest["approved"] or latest["profile"] != source["profile"]:
                return  # A concurrent config edit must not be overwritten by an old check.
            source.update(last_check=self.clock(), next_check=self.clock()+interval, error=None)
            if source["last_hash"] == identity:
                source.update(status="unchanged", last_hash=identity)
                self.put("source", source["id"], source, db)
                return
            if packet["data_class"] != "synthetic" or len(packet["chunks"]) > 20: raise WorkflowError("PACKET_SCOPE_BLOCKED")
            base = self.version(db=db)
            source["generation"] = source.get("generation", 0)+1
            key = "change-"+canonical_hash({"fingerprint": identity, "generation": source["generation"]})[:24]
            for previous in self._packages(("processing", "awaiting_review", "partially_published"), db):
                if previous["source_id"] == source["id"] and previous["status"] not in {"published", "superseded"}:
                    previous.update(status="superseded", stage="superseded")
                    self.put("package", previous["id"], previous, db)
            candidates = self._extract_packet(packet, base["snapshot"], key)
            package = {"id": key, "source_id": source["id"], "fingerprint": identity, "base": base["id"],
                       "packet": packet, "candidates": candidates, "proposals": packet.get("proposals", []),
                       "created_at": self.clock(), "deadline": None, "status": "processing", "stage": "discovered",
                       "published": [], "reviews": {}, "run_id": run["id"], "classification": None}
            self.put("package", key, package, db)
            # As soon as a source requirement changes, it cannot remain a certain obligation.
            for candidate in candidates:
                block_id = key+":"+candidate["object_id"]
                block = {"id": block_id, "object_id": candidate["object_id"], "package_id": key,
                         "reason": "来源要求发生变化，等待专业人员确认", "accepted_hash": None}
                self.put("block", block_id, block, db)
                self.put("audit_gate", block_id, {"time": self.clock()}, db)
            source.update(status="changed", last_hash=identity, current_package=key)
            self.put("source", source["id"], source, db)
            self.put("seen", identity, {"package_id": key}, db)
            self.store.audit("workflow_change_discovered", {"package_id": key, "blocked": [c["object_id"] for c in candidates]}, db)
        self._process(key, run)

def put(self, kind, key, value, db):
        db.execute("INSERT INTO wf_records VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(kind,id) DO UPDATE SET payload=excluded.payload", (kind, key, encoded(value)))

def __init__(self, root, *, clock=time.time, snapshot_path=None):
        self.store = Store(root, clock=clock)
        self.clock = clock
        self._service_cache = OrderedDict()
        self._search_cache = OrderedDict()
        self._cache_lock = threading.RLock()
        self.connections = Connections(ROOT / "config/decision/connections.json")
        self.roles = WiredRoles(OfflineRoles(ROOT / "config/decision/providers.template.json"), self.connections)
        self.classification_config = json.loads((ROOT / "config/preparation/classification.json").read_text("utf-8"))
        with self.store.db(True) as db:
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wf_records(kind TEXT,id TEXT,payload TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(kind,id))")
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wf_versions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT NOT NULL)")
            db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wf_record_status ON wf_records(kind,json_extract(payload,'$.status'))")
            if self.store.get("state", "wf_head", db) is None:
                snapshot = KnowledgeSnapshot.model_validate_json(Path(snapshot_path or ROOT / "config/decision/synthetic.snapshot.json").read_bytes())
                key = self._version(snapshot.model_dump(mode="json"), None, "fixture-bootstrap", db)
                self.store.put("state", "wf_head", key, db)
                self.store.put("state", "wf_documents", {"id": "initial", "assets": [a.model_dump() for a in snapshot.assets],
                    "evidence": [e.model_dump() for e in snapshot.evidence], "vectors": {}, "index_kind": "local_sparse_cosine"}, db)
                self.put("documents", "initial", self.store.get("state", "wf_documents", db), db)
                self.store.put("state", "wf_control", {"paused": True, "interval": 3600, "heartbeat_at": None}, db)
            # Pin legacy registry metadata once; rollback must not use a global registry.
            ontology_id = self.version(db=db)["snapshot"]["versions"]["ontology"]
            if self.get("ontology_version", ontology_id, db) is None:
                self.put("ontology_version", ontology_id, self.rows("ontology", db), db)

def _service(self, version, db):
        # Cache only immutable validated structure, keyed by checked content, never answers.
        if canonical_hash(version["snapshot"]) != version["id"]: raise WorkflowError("VERSION_INTEGRITY_FAILURE")
        with self._cache_lock:
            cached = self._service_cache.get(version["id"])
            if cached is None:
                snapshot = KnowledgeSnapshot.model_validate_json(encoded(version["snapshot"]))
                template = DecisionService(snapshot)
                cached = (template, {r.id: reviewed_hash(r, snapshot) for r in snapshot.requirements})
                self._service_cache[version["id"]] = cached
                if len(self._service_cache) > 8: self._service_cache.popitem(last=False)
            self._service_cache.move_to_end(version["id"])
            service = cached[0].fork()
        hashes = cached[1]
        for block in self.rows("block", db):
            # Old snapshots remain blocked after a newer requirement is resolved.
            key = block["object_id"]
            if key in hashes and (not block.get("accepted_hash") or hashes[key] != block["accepted_hash"]):
                service.availability.suspend(key, change_id=block["package_id"], reason=block["reason"])
        service.availability.epoch = self._count("audit_gate", db)
        return service

def finalize(self, task_id):
        with self.db() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            task = self._get(db, task_id); manifest, gates, _ = self._context(task)
            if task["status"] not in {"can_finalize", "complete"} or task["facts"] != source_facts(manifest):
                raise PreviewError("VERIFIED_TASK_REQUIRED")
            verification = task["verification"]
            path = self.root / (task_id + "-jev.json")
            if source_digest(path.read_bytes()) != verification["receipt_sha256"] or verification["source_binding"] != task["binding"]:
                raise PreviewError("MODEL_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
            response = read(path)["result"]
            expected = {k: v["noul"] for k, v in response["answers"].items()}
            if expected != verification["probabilities"] or verification["threshold"] != .8:
                raise PreviewError("STORED_VERDICT_CHANGED")
            facts = [{**f, "status": "source_supported" if expected[f["id"]] >= .8 else "needs_review",
                      "support": expected[f["id"]]} for f in task["facts"]]
            answer = {"task_id": task_id, "status": "partial_preview", "mode": "public_preview", "data_class": "public",
                "snapshot_binding": task["binding"], "source_facts": facts,
                "pending_business_conclusions": [{"field": k, "status": "paused", "reason": v} for k, v in gates["paused_fields"].items()],
                "unknown_fields": ["advance_days"], "invented_advance_rejected": expected["invented_advance"] <= .2,
                "portal_evidence": manifest["portal"]["status"], "published": False, "formal_approval": False,
                "notice": "真实公开资料的原文解释预览；待核事项不构成现行办理要求，未提交任何申请。"}
            if task["answer"] is not None and task["answer"] != answer:
                raise PreviewError("PERSISTED_ANSWER_CHANGED")
            task.update(status="complete", answer=answer); self._save(db, task)
            return answer
